text.title: 架子上的温度计
text.situation:
开门前，玛雅检查设备。架子上有温度计，门上方挂着时钟。访客到来前，她记下温度。检查仪器是每天的常规任务，并不是每天一个新实验。随后，送货推车从门外哐啷经过。玛雅记下这次干扰，没有假装房间始终安静。

乔：要不断用不同的灯做实验吗？
玛雅：今天不做。先改变座位。
乔：怎样持续记录发生的事？
玛雅：用时钟和这张表。可以记录大家什么时候进来或换座位，不写姓名。

paragraphs.en: Before opening the room, Maya checked the equipment. A thermometer sat on the shelf, and a clock hung above the door. She wrote down the temperature before visitors arrived. Checking the instruments was a routine task, not a new experiment each morning. Later, a delivery trolley rattled past. Maya recorded the disturbance rather than pretend the room had stayed quiet.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Shall we keep running experiments with different lights?
Maya: Not today. We are changing the seats first.
Jo: How will we track what happens?
Maya: With the clock and this sheet. We can record when people enter or change seats without writing down their names.

acceptableAnswers: 实验期间，她们跟踪大家坐在哪里。
